$Comment: Percent chance a tool hit on a block costs no durability, in whole percent points, held at GatherCareMax. ziggfreed-common's care step gives back what the hit took once the engine has charged it, so a hit that breaks the tool still breaks it. Any item's StatModifiers raise it like any stat, and so does an effect's RawStatModifiers. Base 0; Min is a generous negative so a subtractive modifier never clamps.
